summary: Build ISO 13485, MDR 2017/745, and ISO 14971 skills in 5 days. Strengthen compliance, validation, and audit readiness.
lede: Medical device regulatory compliance training helps professionals in regulated device environments interpret requirements and maintain defensible quality records. It supports practical work in device classification, technical documentation, and risk-based quality systems, including ISO 13485 and ISO 14971. Participants also practice complaint and CAPA handling, process validation, supplier oversight, and audit response through applied exercises.
audienceIntro: This medical device regulation and quality training is for professionals who already work inside a regulated device environment and need to strengthen their decision-making, documentation, and audit response capability.
prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with medical device quality or regulatory functions, and prior exposure to ISO 13485, ISO 14971, or MDR 2017/745 will help you move faster through the exercises. No coding or programming is required. Participants should bring a laptop for document review, template completion, and digital workshop exercises, and they should be prepared to review sample technical documentation, CAPA records, complaint summaries, and validation evidence during the course.
